title: de.hubtask.work.item.due_soon.v1
description: An entry's due date is approaching: the scheduler saw it cross the lead in threshold_spec, and says so once per due date (D-03). Single-value enums stand in for `const`, and the bounds of a value are stated in its description rather than as keywords: the contract test validates against this file with the subset of JSON Schema the project implements, and a keyword it silently ignored would be a promise nobody checks. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON (ADR-0007); the tenant, the actor and the causal chain travel as CloudEvents extension attributes, whose names are lower case without separators as the specification requires. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases (domain-model.md §4).

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

source.description: The installation and the bounded context that produced the event.

subject.description: What the event is about, so that a consumer can filter without parsing the payload.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react (ADR-0018).

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP (automation.md §2).

data.description: What is due and how soon. The lead travels with the announcement rather than being implied, so that a rule can say what soon meant and a consumer reading an old event can read it against the lead that was in force then.

collection_id.description: The collection the entry belongs to, and the one an actor's permission to see it is judged against.

due_at.description: The due date this announcement is about, RFC 3339 in UTC (i18n-l10n.md §7).

due_date_only.description: True for an all-day due date: due_at is read as a date in time_zone, never as an instant.

time_zone.description: The IANA zone the due date is local to, present when one was stored (i18n-l10n.md §7).

threshold_spec.description: The lead the entry crossed, as an ISO-8601 duration - PT24H in this version. A fixed lead rather than one derived from the entry's own reminders, so that “due soon” means the same thing to every rule in a workspace.
